data.title: Bitcoin ETFs buy $160M on Monday, total assets surpass $100B
data.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs attracted $160 million in net inflows on Monday, September 14, pushing the category's total net assets past the $100 billion threshold. The buying spree snapped a streak of outflows that had persisted from September 8 through 11.BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) did most…
